reviews.basis: The cited passage verbatim states PROBAST suggested high risk of bias in most studies, especially the analysis domain.
The cited passage verbatim reports only 14 studies did external validation and 33 used interpretation tools, mainly SHAP.
The cited passage verbatim states across 47 included studies LR, RF, XGBoost, and SVM were most commonly used.
The quote confirms eICU and MIMIC-III cohorts, but does not establish these are public databases; overlap with user's public-data scope is inferred.
The quote confirms comparison of 8 ML algorithms, but the claim's added assertion of building time-series models and absence of deep learning is not in this evidence.
The cited passage states the system predicts AKI onset within the first week of ICU stay, matching the user's AKI risk prediction outcome.
